description: This file implements timer management functions for Zephyr RTOS using CMSIS RTOS v2 API, including creation, starting, stopping, deletion, and status checking of timers.

methods.name: zephyr_timer_wrapper
methods.description: Callback wrapper for Zephyr timer, invokes user callback.

methods.name: osTimerNew
methods.description: Creates a new timer with specified callback, type, argument, and attributes.

methods.name: osTimerStart
methods.description: Starts or restarts a timer with specified ticks.

methods.name: osTimerDelete
methods.description: Deletes a timer, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: osTimerGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a timer.

methods.name: osTimerIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if a timer is currently running.
